body.x: ASUS ‘W5F’ notebook equipped with Intel Core Duo platform
NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> ASUS has announced that it plans to release its new laptop ''W5F'' equipped with Intel centrino dual core platform.
By employing Intel''s newest dual core processor T2300 CPU (1.66GHz L2 cash 2MB), it offers an improved multi-tasking performance while reducing battery consumption.

It features a wide 12.1" CSD (Color Shine Display) to meet the customers'' needs for various entertainment contents, and it also enables you to have access to the internet through either wired or wireless network.
1.3 mega pixel webcam which swivels 180-degree and microphones facilitate audio/video communication.
W5F has the same design of W5 notebook series, a winner of reputed CES 2006 Design & Innovation award. ASUS provides two years warranty for free for this model.
It measures 305 x 220 x 27~ 31mm, and weighs 1.8kg(6 cells batteries included)
If you need more information, visit the website or contact 82-1566-6868.
